approval.note: Numbers are plan section 10 gates (top-3 recall 98%, token baseline -20%) plus zero-leak and 100% provenance/freshness gates chosen by the implementing agent. Not approved.

not_measured.real_relevance_ranking: the stand-in is term overlap, not BM25, analyzers, or embeddings; recall on a real OpenSearch index and a real catalogue size is untested
not_measured.paraphrase_robustness: queries are written against the catalogue's vocabulary and aliases; unseen customer wording is not measured
not_measured.live_index: no live OpenSearch validation was run (requires the user's explicit request)
not_measured.baseline: the token baseline is the whole certified catalogue, not the ADS-007 v1 baseline
